faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before you enroll. Can't find your answer? Reach out — we're happy to help.

items.a1: Five departments — Performance, Composition, Technology, Teacher Training and Musicology — covering ten disciplines from classical instruments to music production.
items.q2: Do I need prior musical knowledge to enrol?
items.a2: No. Our beginner track starts from your first notes. Intermediate and advanced tracks are for students who already play.
items.a3: Individual lessons typically run 45 to 60 minutes; ensemble and studio sessions vary by course, from a short workshop to a full semester.
items.a4: From short certificate workshops with no prerequisites through Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctorate degrees.
items.q5: Can I take more than one course at once?
items.a5: Yes. Many students combine a primary instrument with electives in composition, technology, or musicology.
items.q6: Is there a free trial lesson?
items.a6: Yes — every new student gets a first lesson free, with no card required.
items.q7: Do you offer online or in-person lessons?
items.a7: Most core training happens in person in our studios, with select theory and musicology courses available online.
items.q8: What happens after I complete a programme?
items.a8: You receive a verifiable certificate or diploma, and many graduates go on to perform, teach, or produce professionally.
